purposes.title: Pitch deck reference set
guidance: Front-load the audience value and decision context.
Keep slides adaptable in HTML and provide alternatives when distributing PDF.
Prefer concise, readable structure over copying a vendor pitch template.
purposes.limitations: Sources support attention and accessible delivery, not a universal investor-pitch narrative or template.

purposes.title: Dashboard prototype reference set
guidance: Encode direction and desirability with text, signs, or shape in addition to color.
Prefer position and length for comparisons before area or angle.
Use tables for dense comparison tasks, retaining bounded horizontal scrolling where necessary.
purposes.limitations: Practitioner comparison guidance is not a normative standard; live data behavior is outside this static prototype set.

purposes.title: Diagram prototype reference set
guidance: Treat essential two-dimensional layout as a bounded reflow exception.
Bind inline SVG title and description IDs through aria-labelledby.
Provide keyboard and non-color state cues for interactive nodes and edges.
purposes.limitations: The SVG pattern is practitioner-tested rather than normative; exception scope must be assessed per diagram.

purposes.title: Editorial microsite prototype reference set
guidance: Use semantic headings and labels independently from visual styling.
Begin narrow layouts with one column and a bounded reading measure.
Preserve text resizing, spacing overrides, and 320 CSS pixel reflow.
purposes.limitations: Editorial is a prototype subgenre, not a separate project type; exact measures remain system guidance.

purposes.title: Landing-page prototype reference set
guidance: Front-load the value proposition without cramming all content above the fold.
Prioritize the largest visible content so representative LCP can meet the 2.5-second target.
Maintain semantic hierarchy, keyboard access, contrast, and 320 CSS pixel reflow.
purposes.limitations: Attention findings changed across study years; LCP is a performance target, not visual styling guidance.

purposes.title: Design sandbox prototype reference set
guidance: Expose role-based tokens and their component applications without copying vendor token names.
Demonstrate keyboard focus and distinct component states.
Keep spacing scales configurable rather than enforcing a universal eight-pixel grid.
purposes.limitations: Sandbox is a prototype subgenre; exact fonts, values, components, and names remain product-specific.
